gloss: desired amount; requested amount of money

definitions.explanation: The amount of money one wishes to receive, borrow, charge, or be paid. {希望額|きぼうがく} is a standard term in salary negotiations, loan applications, fundraising, donation requests, sales price negotiations, and similar contexts where one party states their preferred figure.

examples.japanese: {希望額|きぼうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To fill in the desired amount.

examples.japanese: ⟦{融資|ゆうし}→融資：04775_yuushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{希望額|きぼうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かれた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I was asked the loan amount I wanted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{希望額|きぼうがく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{尋|たず}ねられた→尋ねる：01175_tazuneru⟧。
examples.english: At the interview, I was also asked my desired annual salary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売却|ばいきゃく}→売却：12123_baikyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{希望額|きぼうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{相場|そうば}→相場：07668_souba⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧しすぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{買|か}い{手|て}→買い手：24770_kaite⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧つかない{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you set your asking price too far above market rates, there is a risk that buyers will be hard to find.

notes:
{希望額|きぼうがく} is the amount of money one wishes to receive or pay. It appears most commonly on application forms, in negotiations, and in transaction listings.

FORMS:
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧ ("hope, wish, desire") + ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ ("amount of money") → {希望額|きぼうがく}

USAGE:
- ⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{希望額|きぼうがく}: desired annual salary (job applications, interviews)
- ⟦{融資|ゆうし}→融資：04775_yuushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{希望額|きぼうがく}: requested loan amount
- ⟦{売却|ばいきゃく}→売却：12123_baikyaku⟧{希望額|きぼうがく}: desired sale price (real estate, used cars)
- ⟦{寄付|きふ}→寄付：02584_kifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{希望額|きぼうがく}: suggested donation amount
- ⟦{査定|さてい}→査定：07518_satei⟧{希望額|きぼうがく}: desired appraisal amount
- On Japanese application and questionnaire forms, you will frequently see fields labeled simply {希望額|きぼうがく} with a numeric input.
- {希望額|きぼうがく} is neutral in formality; it is used in business letters, contracts, and form labels alike.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {希望額|きぼうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill in the desired amount (on a form)
- {希望額|きぼうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to communicate the desired amount
- {希望額|きぼうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下回|したまわ}る→下回る：07649_shitamawaru⟧: to fall below the requested amount
- {希望額|きぼうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧ / ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to lower / raise one's requested amount
- {希望額|きぼうがく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}かない→届く：00899_todoku⟧: to not reach the requested amount

- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: desired price — used in sales contexts; closely related but emphasizes the price tag of an item rather than a sum of money in general
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧: desired annual income (a frequent collocation in job applications)
- ⟦{見積|みつ}もり→見積もり：05153_mitsumori⟧⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧: estimated/quoted amount — what is offered, not what is requested
- ⟦{提示|ていじ}→提示：12905_teiji⟧⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧: offered amount, the amount put forth (e.g., by an employer or buyer)
- ⟦{目安|めやす}→目安：00276_meyasu⟧: rough guideline, ballpark figure — softer than {希望額|きぼうがく}
